source.note: THE extra-combat EDGE witness (CR 500.8, the Aggravated Assault / Breath of Fury infinite-combat family). Commander Spellbook combo 900-3750 (popularity 33167, colour identity R, result 'Infinite combat phases'), which lists the two named enablers; the third piece is the prerequisite EQUIPPED CREATURE (any creature — its ports are the UNIVERSAL combat-presence projection, PortGraph.ProjectCombatPresence: an attacksorblocks:self consume + a Gated emit:damage:combat:any, both derived for every creature with a P/T profile). All ports are AST-derivable (live engine): Aggravated Assault -> EffectType additionalCombatAndMainPhase -> emit:additionalcombat (subject {Controller:You}); Sword -> Trigger.Event DealsCombatDamageToPlayer + EffectType untap {land, Controller:You} -> emit:untap(land). The ADR-2 interim stem is 'combat' with phase=additional (emit) / scope=self (consume) (CombatEmitFamily / AttacksConsumeFamily); the phase/scope facets have NO ADR-3 licensed axis and are DELIBERATELY folded into the bare event verb combat-presence (O21 / event_verbs def: 'emit:additionalcombat re-raises the phase that produces it') — the emit vs consume distinction is carried by side + the control (you) / subject (self) axes, not lost. TRUE self-loop: the same equipped creature re-attacks, deals combat damage, untaps lands, refunds {3}{R}{R}, and attacks again — no sacrifice/swap (unlike Breath of Fury), so the combat-presence[self] subscription stays on ONE object.

judge.ref: ij 2026-07-17 b6 — combat->attacks AMBER (control!=subsumes self + Gated choice); guard:extra-combat-gated sound; PROCEED

Aggravated Assault.note: the {R}{R} colour-critical pips of the {3}{R}{R} activation cost; the untap→mana bridge target (E2). The bridge tiers AMBER precisely because untapped lands' colours are unknown — it cannot certify they cover RR (CR 107.4)
the {3} generic remainder of the cost (any colour pays it); shown for cost totality

THE ADDITIONAL-COMBAT DRIVER — 'after this main phase, there is an additional combat phase' (EffectType additionalCombatAndMainPhase; the extra MAIN phase is irrelevant to the loop and collapses away). Live label emit:additionalcombat, subject {Controller:You}. Modelled as an emit on the bare event verb combat-presence: an additional combat phase re-raises the combat-presence of the creatures YOU control (control=you). This is the EMIT-side witness of combat-presence (Kari Zev witnessed the consume side only).

incidental / enabler — 'untap all creatures you control' discharges the attacker's tapped-from-attacking state (CR 508.1g) so it can attack in the extra combat. NOT load-bearing for engine closure: ProjectCombatPresence's re-attack consume (EC1) is Gated but not tap-gated, so the loop closes through E3 without this port; shown for card faithfulness

Sword of Feast and Famine.note: 'whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player' — a combat-damage subscription (AST Trigger.Event=DealsCombatDamageToPlayer, Filter {creature, IsEquipped}). subject=attached: Sword watches the creature ATTACHED to it (the equipped creature); combat + player facets both AST-derivable. damage-dealt already witnessed by ancient-copper-dragon

'you untap all lands you control' (EffectType untap, Target Each, Filter {land, Controller:You}) — the mana source. Same shape as deadeye-x-peregrine-drake PD2 (structure:untap subtype=land); the untapped lands can be tapped again for mana (CR 305.4/605) — the untap→mana bridge
incidental — 'that player discards a card' (the punisher half); not part of the loop, shown for card faithfulness

Equipped Creature.note: the RE-ATTACK subscription — the universal combat-presence consume ProjectCombatPresence projects for every creature (live label attacksorblocks:self, Gated, subject {IsSelf}). THE consume the additional-combat driver satisfies (E3). Identical stem+facet to the Kari Zev combat-presence[subject=self] witness

the Gated combat-damage emit ProjectCombatPresence projects for every creature (live label emit:damage:combat:any, Gated, subject {IsSelf}). recipient=any (combat damage hits the blocking creature OR the defending player, CR 510.1). GATED: attacking is once per combat — this is the §8 soundness floor that keeps every extra-combat loop AMBER, never a false GREEN

notes: the equipped creature's combat damage feeds Sword's 'deals combat damage to a player' subscription. Facets compatible: combat→combat (CR 510); recipient any→player (any overlaps player, CR 510.1). subject self intersects attached (the attacker IS the equipped creature) → Overlaps not Subsumes → AMBER. Reuses policy:subscription:subject-intersect (confirmed, deadeye)

untapping all your lands refunds Aggravated Assault's {3}{R}{R}. Reuses bridge:untap-land-to-mana (confirmed, deadeye-x-peregrine-drake) — CORROBORATES it with a second witness. AMBER ceiling: untapped lands' colours/count are unknown, so the engine cannot certify they cover the RR pips (CR 107.4)

THE HEADLINE WITNESS — emit:additionalcombat (combat-presence, control=you) satisfies the re-attack subscription (combat-presence, subject=self): the additional combat phase lets this creature attack AGAIN (CR 500.8), re-driving its Gated combat-damage emit and closing the infinite-combat loop. control=you covers subject=self (this creature is one you control), which alone would read Subsumes→GREEN — but re-attacking is a CHOICE (CR 508.1a 'if any') and the combat-damage it re-drives is Gated, so guard:extra-combat-gated floors it AMBER, never a false GREEN. Live arm: PortGraphEngine.FlowFeasible ("additionalcombat","attacksorblocks") + ExtraCombatArmScopeTest

ProjectCombatPresence's card-defined edge: attacking (the combat-presence re-attack) deterministically leads to dealing combat damage (CR 510) — but the combat-damage emit is Gated (attacking is a choice / may be blocked), so the hop carries the AMBER floor
the triggered ability's own causality: the combat-damage-to-a-player trigger deterministically untaps all your lands (structural, self-certifying)

the activated ability's own causality: paying {3}{R}{R} (AA1/AA2) deterministically produces the additional combat phase (structural, self-certifying). OnlyAsSorcery is a timing restriction, not a §8 hard gate — the extra MAIN phase re-enables sorcery-speed activation, so it never floors the loop

guards.desc: an additional-combat driver (an emit on combat-presence, control=you — 'there is an additional combat phase', CR 500.8) that satisfies a creature's re-attack subscription (combat-presence, subject=self) can NEVER certify GREEN, even though control=you covers subject=self: re-attacking is a CHOICE (CR 508.1a 'if any' — attackers are declared, never forced), the attacker may be blocked, and the combat-damage it re-drives is Gated (once per combat, CR 510). So any loop through the extra-combat re-attack floors to AMBER — the §8 soundness floor for the extra-combat arm, mirroring how the Gated combat-damage emit prevents a false GREEN

assertions.because: guard:extra-combat-gated: re-attacking is a choice (CR 508.1a) and the re-driven combat-damage is Gated — the extra-combat edge never certifies GREEN

assertions.claim: edge.E3 witnesses combat-presence emit -> combat-presence:self consume
assertions.because: AA3 (emit combat-presence, control=you — the additional-combat driver) feeds EC1 (consume combat-presence, subject=self — the re-attack subscription): the CR 500.8 extra-combat re-attack edge, closing the infinite-combat loop

AA3 projects combat-presence on the EMIT side (the additional-combat driver) — kari-zev-skyship-raider witnessed only the consume side; this turns the bare event verb's emit half into a witnessed fact
bridge:untap-land-to-mana ceiling (untapped lands' colours/count unknown, CR 107.4); this gold is a second witness — corroborates deadeye-x-peregrine-drake

policy:subscription:subject-intersect: the combat-damage emit (subject=self) Overlaps Sword's equipped-creature subscription (subject=attached), and recipient any→player is an over-approximation (CR 510.1)

the loop passes through EC2 (Gated combat-damage) and E3 (guard:extra-combat-gated) — both floor the cycle to AMBER; a true self-loop that is nonetheless UNcertifiable as reliably infinite (re-attacking is a choice, the attacker may be blocked)
